title: Slovakian Velvet Pois Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup made with the finest slovakian ingredients.
instructions: Peel and dice the slovakian velvet potatoes.
In a large pot, sauté the kissed onion and petit garlic in a little bit of oil until softened.
Add the pois and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, slovakian velvet potatoes, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Puree the soup with an immersion blender or transfer to a blender and blend until smooth.
Return the soup to the pot and let it simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of chopped parsley or chives if desired.
